title: skills: protocol.md tags `BreakpointColumnMap` with `responsive-grid`, a node type key objectui#11441 retired
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a shipped-surface sentence that is wrong after a landing, with a named location.

`reach:` a named real producer. `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md:340` belongs to the shipped `objectui` skill, which agents authoring objectui metadata read, and it names `responsive-grid` beside `BreakpointColumnMap`. At `9d1c0bff9` the registry carries no `responsive-grid` or `layout:responsive-grid` registration: `packages/layout/src/index.ts` has exactly two `ComponentRegistry.register(` calls, `page:card` and `app-schema-renderer`, read by the seat. So a node authored from that parenthetical renders the "Unknown component type" panel. `objectui validate` refuses it at `type`, as it already did before the retirement.

## Where
`skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md:340`, in the grid `2xl` paragraph:

> `BreakpointColumnMap` in `@object-ui/layout` (`responsive-grid`) spells the same six.

PR objectui#11460 (objectui#11441, the maintainer's ruling `5950208338`) retired the `responsive-grid` node type key and its `layout:` twin, at `9d1c0bff9`. The parenthetical now tags the map with a registry key that no longer resolves. An agent reading the skill can take `responsive-grid` for an authorable node.

What still holds, at `9d1c0bff9`:
- `BreakpointColumnMap` is still exported from `@object-ui/layout`. It is declared in `ResponsiveGrid.tsx`, beside `resolveColumnClasses`, and types the `ResponsiveGrid` React component's `columns` prop.
- `ResponsiveGrid` stays a React-only export. Only the node type key is gone.
- The rest of the paragraph (six keys, `grid` reads all six, the measured class ramps) is unaffected.

## Why it was not fixed in PR objectui#11460
`skills/**` is a governed surface (Tier H, a human merge). Riding it on the code PR would have turned the whole PR into a human-merge landing. The contract review `5952311465` (item ③.3) recorded the site as correctly left out, for a follow-up.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)
The parenthetical names what still exists: the `ResponsiveGrid` component's `columns` prop, or no parenthetical at all. One sentence, one file. The rest of the paragraph stays.

Reader who acts: the objectui `domain:skills` seat (seat post objectui#11311), or whichever lane triage routes governed `skills/**` edits to. The precedent for this paragraph is objectui#7599, which was fixed by PR objectui#10708 (a human merge). ⛔ Not graded here; triage grades.

## Dedupe
- MCP issue search on objectui (protocol.md, responsive-grid, BreakpointColumnMap, retired layout registration): 30 hits. None is an open card for this sentence. The nearest are objectui#7599 (closed, same paragraph, a different owner name) and objectui#10720 (closed, the `ResponsiveGrid` docblock).
- REST scan of the 900 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, open and closed:
  - `protocol.md` together with `responsive-grid` or `BreakpointColumnMap`: 2 hits, objectui#7599 and PR objectui#10708, both closed and both predating the retirement;
  - `responsive-grid`: 7 hits, all on the retirement itself (objectui#11441, PR objectui#11460, objectui#11440, PR objectui#10870, PR objectui#11457) or the closed precedent.
